lines.zh: 轻轻跳着走，风在羽毛边打转。
lines.en: Hopping lightly, wind swirling past my feathers.

lines.zh: 短腿快倒腾，别嫌我走得慢。
lines.en: Little legs working fast—don't call me slow.

lines.zh: 云路软软的，每一步都像弹跳。
lines.en: The cloud path is soft; every step feels like a bounce.

lines.zh: 我沿着浮岛边缘走，很小心的。
lines.en: I walk along the floating isle's edge, very carefully.

lines.zh: 尾巴一翘一翘，保持平衡呢。
lines.en: Tail flicking up and down to keep balance.

lines.zh: 风大也不怕，我贴着地面走。
lines.en: Strong wind doesn't scare me; I hug the ground.

lines.zh: 小爪子踩过草叶，沙沙作响。
lines.en: Tiny claws rustle over the grass blades.

lines.zh: 走两步停一下，看看四周。
lines.en: Two steps, then a pause to look around.

lines.zh: 我个头小，走路得躲着大影子。
lines.en: I'm tiny, so I dodge the big shadows while walking.

lines.zh: 沿着岛边散步，风景真好。
lines.en: Strolling by the isle's edge—what a view.

lines.zh: 翅膀收好，走路才稳当。
lines.en: Wings tucked in—walking is steadier this way.

lines.zh: 草籽蹭到脚边，我绕开走。
lines.en: Seeds brush my feet; I step around them.

lines.zh: 慢慢挪过去，那边风小些。
lines.en: Inching over there—less wind on that side.

lines.zh: 走快了会飘，我得压着步子。
lines.en: Too fast and I'd drift; I keep my steps low.

lines.zh: 小身影在浮岛间蹦跶着前进。
lines.en: A small figure bounces forward between floating isles.

lines.zh: 别踩空，云缝里可深着呢。
lines.en: Don't step into gaps—those cloud cracks go deep.

lines.zh: 缩成一团，像颗小棉球。
lines.en: Tucked into a ball, like a little cotton puff.

lines.zh: 风把羽毛吹乱，我理一理。
lines.en: Wind ruffles my feathers; I smooth them down.

lines.zh: 安静待着，听浮岛的风声。
lines.en: Resting quietly, listening to the floating isle's wind.

lines.zh: 脑袋歪一歪，在发呆呢。
lines.en: Head tilted—just spacing out.

lines.zh: 眯起眼，晒晒天境的柔光。
lines.en: Eyes half-closed, basking in the Aether's soft light.

lines.zh: 小爪子缩进羽毛里取暖。
lines.en: Tiny claws tucked into feathers for warmth.

lines.zh: 站着不动，假装自己是团云。
lines.en: Standing still, pretending to be a cloud puff.

lines.zh: 轻轻抖了抖尾羽，歇口气。
lines.en: A gentle tail-feather shake—catching my breath.

lines.zh: 这里风平浪静，正适合打盹。
lines.en: Calm winds here—perfect for a nap.

lines.zh: 我蹲在草里，只露个小脑袋。
lines.en: Crouched in the grass, only my little head showing.

lines.zh: 远处有动静，我先按兵不动。
lines.en: Something stirs far off; I hold perfectly still.

lines.zh: 羽毛蓬松起来，暖洋洋的。
lines.en: Feathers fluffed up, warm and cozy.

lines.zh: 你这么大个，我有点紧张。
lines.en: You're so big—I'm a bit nervous.

lines.zh: 歪头看你，你会不会突然动？
lines.en: Head tilted at you—will you suddenly move?

lines.zh: 我盯着你呢，别靠太近。
lines.en: I've got my eye on you—don't come too close.

lines.zh: 我这么小，你的影子够我躲。
lines.en: I'm small enough to hide in your shadow.

lines.zh: 轻轻叫一声，算打招呼了。
lines.en: A soft chirp—consider it a hello.

lines.zh: 你手里没吃的吧？我看看。
lines.en: Nothing edible in your hands? Let me check.

lines.zh: 我往后退半步，保持距离。
lines.en: I step back half a pace, keeping distance.

lines.zh: 我白得像一小团雪。
lines.en: I'm white as a little snowball.

lines.zh: 小眼睛眨巴眨巴，打量你。
lines.en: Little eyes blinking, sizing you up.

lines.zh: 别伸手，我胆子可不大。
lines.en: Don't reach out—I'm not very brave.

lines.zh: 疼！羽毛都炸开了。
lines.en: Ouch! My feathers are all puffed out.

lines.zh: 我被打得直打转。
lines.en: The hit sends me spinning.

lines.zh: 缩成一团，先躲一下。
lines.en: Curled into a ball—hiding for a moment.

lines.zh: 翅膀有点发软，飞不动。
lines.en: My wings feel weak—can't fly.

lines.zh: 谁打我？我都没看清。
lines.en: Who hit me? I didn't even see.

lines.zh: 我蹦到一边，直喘气。
lines.en: I hop aside, panting hard.

lines.zh: 疼得叫了一声，真丢脸。
lines.en: Let out a yelp of pain—how embarrassing.

lines.zh: 羽毛乱了，我得缓一缓。
lines.en: Feathers in disarray—I need a moment.

lines.zh: 这一下可不轻，我站不稳。
lines.en: That one was heavy—I can't stand steady.

lines.zh: 我退到草后，先不出来了。
lines.en: I retreat behind the grass and stay put.

lines.zh: 你手上那点东西，我有点好奇。
lines.en: Whatever's in your hand—I'm a little curious.

lines.zh: 凑近半步，又赶紧退回来。
lines.en: Half a step closer, then quickly back.

lines.zh: 歪着脑袋，盯着你的手指看。
lines.en: Head tilted, staring at your fingers.

lines.zh: 是给我的吗？我不太确定。
lines.en: Is that for me? I'm not quite sure.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转半圈，拿不定主意。
lines.en: I circle half around you, undecided.

lines.zh: 喉咙里咕噜一声，有点心动。
lines.en: A little chirp in my throat—I'm tempted.

lines.zh: 再靠近一点，我可就信你了。
lines.en: One step closer and I might trust you.

lines.zh: 小爪子原地刨了刨，忍不住了。
lines.en: Tiny claws scratching in place—I can't resist.

lines.zh: 你的影子晃了晃，我停住了。
lines.en: Your shadow shifts—I freeze.

lines.zh: 我探头探脑，就是不敢上前。
lines.en: Peeking and peering, but not daring to approach.

lines.zh: 哎哟，撞到你腿上了。
lines.en: Oops—bumped into your leg.

lines.zh: 我个头小，撞一下弹老远。
lines.en: I'm tiny; one bump sends me bouncing back.

lines.zh: 没看路，脑袋撞得晕乎乎。
lines.en: Wasn't watching—my head's spinning from the bump.

lines.zh: 羽毛都撞乱了，真丢脸。
lines.en: Feathers all mussed—how embarrassing.

lines.zh: 你像堵墙，我撞得直退。
lines.en: You're like a wall; the bump pushes me back.

lines.zh: 扑棱两下才站稳，别笑我。
lines.en: Flapped twice to steady myself—don't laugh.

lines.zh: 我绕开你走，省得再撞。
lines.en: I'll walk around you to avoid another bump.

lines.zh: 轻轻一碰，我就歪到一边。
lines.en: A light bump and I tip right over.

lines.zh: 撞完赶紧理羽毛，装作没事。
lines.en: After the bump I smooth feathers, acting casual.

lines.zh: 这地方太挤，我贴边走。
lines.en: Too crowded here—I'll hug the edge.

lines.zh: 我抖抖羽毛，想让你看看。
lines.en: I ruffle my feathers, wanting you to see.

lines.zh: 靠近一点，又害羞地别过头。
lines.en: Edging closer, then shyly turning away.

lines.zh: 轻轻叫两声，声音软软的。
lines.en: Two soft chirps, gentle and low.

lines.zh: 我们在草里并排待着吧。
lines.en: Let's rest side by side in the grass.

lines.zh: 尾巴碰尾巴，算不算答应？
lines.en: Tail touching tail—does that count as yes?

lines.zh: 我围着你蹦一小圈。
lines.en: I hop a small circle around you.

lines.zh: 风把羽毛吹开，我不躲了。
lines.en: Wind parts my feathers—I don't hide now.

lines.zh: 慢慢靠近，别急着惊动我。
lines.en: Come slowly—don't startle me.

lines.zh: 并排蹲着，安安静静的。
lines.en: Crouched side by side, all quiet.

lines.zh: 我歪头蹭了蹭你旁边的草。
lines.en: I tilt my head and nuzzle the grass beside you.

lines.zh: 一根亮线，我叼着甩了甩。
lines.en: A shiny thread; I pick it up and shake it.

lines.zh: 用小爪子扒拉半天，总算拿住。
lines.en: Pawing at it a while—finally got hold.

lines.zh: 这是什么？亮晶晶的，我收着。
lines.en: What's this? All shiny—I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 叼在嘴里，走路都小心了。
lines.en: Carrying it in my beak, I walk extra carefully.

lines.zh: 太重啦，我叼得歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: Too heavy—I wobble carrying it.

lines.zh: 先放下，再叼起来试试。
lines.en: Set it down, then try picking it up again.

lines.zh: 我捡东西的样子很认真吧？
lines.en: I look pretty serious picking things up, right?

lines.zh: 这个归我了，谁也别抢。
lines.en: This one's mine—nobody grab it.

lines.zh: 叼着跑两步，又怕掉了。
lines.en: Run two steps with it, then fear it'll drop.

lines.zh: 小玩意儿，藏进羽毛底下。
lines.en: A little trinket—tucked under my feathers.

lines.zh: 那边有东西，我盯上了。
lines.en: Something over there—I've got my eye on it.

lines.zh: 毛都竖起来了，准备着呢。
lines.en: Feathers up—I'm getting ready.

lines.zh: 翅膀收紧，我从枝头探出。
lines.en: Wings tucked, I lean out from the branch.

lines.zh: 看见你了，别以为我小就好骗。
lines.en: I see you—don't think I'm easy to fool.

lines.zh: 翅膀收紧，先看清楚再说。
lines.en: Wings tight—let me get a clear look first.

lines.zh: 这家伙有点大，我犹豫了。
lines.en: That one's a bit big—I hesitate.

lines.zh: 我跳上高点，方便盯着。
lines.en: I hop to a higher spot to keep watch.

lines.zh: 脖子一伸，锁定目标。
lines.en: Neck stretched—target locked.

lines.zh: 小声咕哝，给自己壮胆。
lines.en: A quiet mutter to bolster my courage.

lines.zh: 先别动，等它露出破绽。
lines.en: Hold still—wait for an opening.

lines.zh: 我一直看着呢，别想溜。
lines.en: I'm still watching—don't try to slip away.

lines.zh: 绕半圈，换个角度盯。
lines.en: Circling halfway to watch from another angle.

lines.zh: 雪白的小脑袋跟着你歪。
lines.en: My little white head tilts after you.

lines.zh: 眼睛不眨，脖子有点酸。
lines.en: Not blinking—my neck's getting sore.

lines.zh: 风往那边吹，我顺着看。
lines.en: Wind blows that way; I follow with my gaze.

lines.zh: 我贴地跟着，不出声。
lines.en: Hugging the ground, trailing silently.

lines.zh: 太近了不行，我再退一点。
lines.en: Too close—I'll back off a bit more.

lines.zh: 耐心等着，急不得。
lines.en: Waiting patiently—no rushing.

lines.zh: 它好像发现我了，我装作看云。
lines.en: Think it spotted me—I'll pretend to watch clouds.

lines.zh: 盯久了，翅膀都僵了。
lines.en: Watched so long my wings have gone stiff.

lines.zh: 扑过去啄一下，赶紧退开。
lines.en: Dart in for a peck, then quickly back off.

lines.zh: 我冲上去撞它一下！
lines.en: I rush in and bump it!

lines.zh: 小爪子抓一把，转身就跑。
lines.en: A quick claw swipe, then I turn and flee.

lines.zh: 翅膀拍它脸，趁乱溜走。
lines.en: Wings flapping at its face—I slip away in the chaos.

lines.zh: 我跳起来啄，落点没算准。
lines.en: I leap to peck, but misjudge the landing.

lines.zh: 一下一下地戳，不敢恋战。
lines.en: Jabbing bit by bit—not daring to linger.

lines.zh: 打中了，我赶紧扑棱退后。
lines.en: Hit it—I flap hurriedly backward.

lines.zh: 它比我大好多，我有点慌。
lines.en: It's so much bigger—I'm a bit panicked.

lines.zh: 边打边看退路，随时准备跑。
lines.en: Striking while eyeing an escape route, ready to run.

lines.zh: 啄完就躲到草后面喘气。
lines.en: After the peck I hide behind grass to catch my breath.

lines.zh: 我从风里掉出来，羽毛乱飞。
lines.en: I tumble out of the wind, feathers flying.

lines.zh: 睁眼一看，这是天境？
lines.en: Eyes open—is this the Aether?

lines.zh: 落在一片浮岛上，脚有点发软。
lines.en: Landed on a floating isle, my legs a bit shaky.

lines.zh: 抖抖羽毛，先把方向认清。
lines.en: Shaking out my feathers, getting my bearings first.

lines.zh: 周围好大，我缩成一小团。
lines.en: So much space around—I shrink into a tiny ball.

lines.zh: 风从下面吹上来，凉飕飕的。
lines.en: Wind blows up from below, chilly.

lines.zh: 我先叫一声，看看有没有回应。
lines.en: I chirp once to see if anything answers.

lines.zh: 脚下是云，我小心踩了踩。
lines.en: Clouds underfoot—I test them carefully.

lines.zh: 新地方，得先找片草躲躲。
lines.en: New place—I should find some grass to hide in.

lines.zh: 就这样，我出现在这儿了。
lines.en: And just like that, here I am.

lines.zh: 热浪扑过来，我赶紧躲远。
lines.en: A wave of heat—I scramble far away.

lines.zh: 往下掉！我拼命扑棱翅膀。
lines.en: Falling! I flap my wings desperately.

lines.zh: 水灌进羽毛，我慌了神。
lines.en: Water soaks my feathers—I panic.

lines.zh: 轰的一声，我被震得滚出去。
lines.en: A boom—I'm blasted rolling away.

lines.zh: 有东西飞过来，擦到我了。
lines.en: Something flew at me and grazed me.

lines.zh: 奇怪的光罩住我，浑身发麻。
lines.en: Strange light wraps me—my whole body tingles.

lines.zh: 肚子空空的，我没什么力气。
lines.en: My belly's empty—I've little strength left.

lines.zh: 一道亮光劈下来，我吓得趴下。
lines.en: A flash strikes down—I drop flat in fright.

lines.zh: 云海空了，羽毛乱飞。
lines.en: The cloud sea is empty; my feathers scatter.
